normality_crossfit: held development bucket; inner calibration fits with one bucket use complete held week groups
calibration: LogisticRegression C=1 on raw reference scores from inner held buckets, natural SMART class prevalence, no local data
threshold: fixed 0.5 and training-only maximum recall subject to FPR<=0.10; ties balanced accuracy then largest threshold
permutation_policy: shuffle auxiliary labels within original source, preserve counts; diagnostic controls, not eligible final candidates
selection: real multibase variants only; unchanged prototype gates on nested held-group results; choose raw or sigmoid by lower Brier, then log loss; ties choose fewer sources. Freeze one candidate before reserved evaluation. No configuration chosen from final test.
probability_scope: probability of provider reference class in SMART cohort only; sparse positive groups preclude a universal physical-failure probability
source_contribution: compare matching anchor leaf, fair training-only threshold and shuffled auxiliary references; improvement at a fixed threshold alone does not establish transferred physical information
local_input_change: completed real operating cycles and previous confirmed cycles are required; sensor POST alone does not provide boundaries
test_policy: one frozen pipeline; all test scores recorded once; failed test becomes consumed evidence, never threshold tuning
